title: Conditional κ = 0.0010179165948676969: E8 enlarged ordered entrances and 32-replica banks
body:
This adds a source-bound composition of enlarged entrance spaces, ordered donor promotions and a new literal bank packing. The exact **conditional κ is `508958297433848428641873 / (5 × 10²⁶) ≈ 0.0010179165948676969`**.

The additive package is `research/e8-enlarged-sequential-composition`. Its complex coarse bound is `509476902427531203043 / (5 × 10²³) ≈ 0.0010189538048550624`; the freshly replayed signed-nine bit bound remains `255384852701747 / 250000000000000000 ≈ 0.001021539410806988`. The complex supplier binds.

The exact gain over our frozen shared-donor parent is `1249634660945321277371 / 10²⁷`, about **0.12291485%**. Compared with pinned PR410's reported `508781072593909 / (5 × 10¹⁷)`, the gain is `177224839939428641873 / (5 × 10²⁶)`, about **0.03483322%**. These comparisons use named frozen constructions.

### Construction and attribution

**eumemic's [PR410](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/410)**, prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and pinned at `95ad14d5359d62a89e7bb06eb59b68029e77fb6f`, supplies eight exact entrance-space enlargements and the finite admission machinery. We apply those eight enlargements to the original **194** shared-donor relations. Every affected pivot retains its original rational response relation. PR410's 205-relation selection and its separate 206th promotion are not used.

Then **Rohan Arun's [PR409](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/409)**, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and pinned at `212e03d7665d08fc6a037d3e33612cb7fc60874d`, supplies all **ten ordered donor-to-pivot promotions through 51 prepended shears**. This gives **204 gauges of total entrance dimension 362**. The literal prefix satisfies source-before-write ordering; `N²` is nonzero and `N³ = 0`. The complete word is checked independently, so nilpotency is not used as a substitute for endpoint normalization.

The fresh frozen parent's complete target schedule is retained, including both commuting windows and **Chafik Boukhalfa's PR402 targets 177/220 re-synthesis through donor 221, assisted by Anthropic Claude**. The overlapping 124→125 recovery from the upstream branch is absent. Dugongue's PR404/401 shared-donor and two-sided normalization machinery remains credited. Earlier R781/R822, frame, prefix, geometry and compiler notices remain intact.

A new **32-replica packing** uses **2943 banks per stage and 1495 rank-one padding blocks per stage**, with **57,207 live slots and 57,998 physical slots**. Full emission derives **1,285,839 paid children**, rank mass **4,166,127**, deficit **9,984**, **117,504 explicit bank boundary adapters**, and per-vertex coefficient **2,511,691,089,674,295**. The unchanged PR403 replica-parametric bank emitter, independent decoder and bridge are retained through pinned PR409 sources. The exact profile is repriced; independently reported gains are not added. The separate appendix below proves only the stated fixed-inventory padding optimum.

### Arithmetic domain and conditional scope

The unchanged legacy fixed-sixths `gxcore` mirror **rejects** gauged dirty intermediates at register 275. Its clean-X replay passes. The diagnostic reproduces and preserves that rejection; **no unchanged gxcore or Lean-facing acceptance is claimed**.

Separately, exact rational raw maps and a replay of the actual paid scalar primitive expansion pass on all **1021 independent columns**, in both orientations. Every copy, clear, accumulate, double, HALF and divide3 operation is executed. Endpoints and private cleanup pass; primitive and projection hashes agree with the invoice. Every **2,993 HALF** and **1,344 divide3** operation per orientation is charged. Observed primitive-prefix denominator LCM is **12 forward and 24 backward**, with maximum numerator 7 and absolute value 4.

This is finite evidence for the admitted rational primitive model. All-size normalized-window lifts, arbitrary correlated-bank substitution, recursive compiler/chart realization, prime/setup/recovery/precision, common-grid realization, fixed tapes/restored rows, analytic interfaces and a common dominating stage-specific `C_full` remain conditional. No unconditional multiplication theorem or separately materialized all-size global instruction stream is claimed.

### Fixed-inventory padding appendix

The separate seven-file [residual-padding certificate](https://github.com/applecrusher/integer-mult-bounds/blob/codex-e8-reuse-extension/research/e8-residual-padding-bound/PROOF.md) proves that this fixed rank inventory and width 73 have minimum padding moment **`1495 × (73^α − 1)` for `0 < α ≤ 1/100`**. It exhausts all **4765** legal bank patterns and checks an exact rational dual certificate using integer powers; the supplied packing attains equality. The result covers arbitrary splitting of padding, but does not optimize the real-child inventory, bank width, local construction, full compiler invoice or the multiplication score globally. It neither changes the frozen 21-file construction package nor supplies an additional numerical gain. The workflow runs its stdlib-only verifier as a separate step and retains the receipt.

### Complete fresh replay

The default reruns the entire frozen shared-donor parent and all ancestors, including the native nine-stage bit construction, complete signed-prefix correction and dyadic geometry. It then checks:

- Source-bound original 119 and enlarged 194 reconstruction, the fresh parent target transplant, and the unchanged PR409 ordered constructor. Full raw maps and retained totals match; every frame transition is nested.
- All six actual target setup/restore/delivery mutations, the native new-entrance omission and reversed-layer controls, **535 entrance omission witnesses**, three full symbolic controls, and seven lifecycle/scalar mutations per orientation.
- The complete emitted response/main/cleanup stream from **204 independent helper operator tokens**, all 781 helper diagonals, private cleanup, and both actual first-entrance omission controls.
- All **836 new/reflected exact Gaussian phase pairs**, **22,016 native address-column checks across 43 boundary frames**, fresh source-bound prior phases, explicit two-sided adapters, complete bank schedules, owner routes and independent finite invoice decoding.
- The corrected signed-nine coefficient **71,903,549,476,531** and **91-bit prefix**, fresh 12360-matrix dyadic checks and degree-two `72² > 2·50²`, both exact moment engines, eight charged continuations and all **47 strict outer constraints**. `eta = beta = 10^-30`; the counted common outer `log2` threshold is **14 × 10³⁰**. Required complex row coefficient **15,449** stays below **20,161**.

```sh
python -B research/e8-enlarged-sequential-composition/verify.py /absolute/path/to/new-output
```

The workflow runs this full default on Python 3.12/3.13 with C++17/Boost and retains the evidence. Four ASCII carriers restore **414 exact native files**: all 193 PR410 files and 221 files across the five pinned PR409 dependency trees. All six native manifests, Git-blob and SHA256 pins are checked; malformed transport, path and allocation controls are retained. The wrapper checks all **15 frozen dependency inventories** again before success. Existing source packages and workflows remain unchanged.
